review.rationale: Primary review of all 30 cards on the official WPI ECE faculty page (25 under Faculty, 5 under Staff), reconciled with a full-roster independent Haiku audit that fetched all 30 profiles. Teaching-track, practice-track, adjunct and staff entries are excluded; one affiliate assistant professor is included; the Associate Dean is included on the university's appointment announcement stating a professorship in Electrical Engineering. The six Professor Emeritus rows in the emeriti table are not roster entries here (excluded category, not parsed by the collector).
review.independent_review_scope: Full-roster independent audit of 30 directory entries.
